turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, I'm Dov Castellane. I run a pottery studio called Kiln and Clover in Quillhaven. Could solar help with my electricity bill?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Dov, this is Ansel at Fernhollow Solar. Very likely. What uses the most power in the studio?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Easier to say than type. It's the kiln by a long way. It's electric, and I fire it twice a week, on Tuesdays and Saturdays. A firing runs for about ten hours and I start it at seven in the morning. Everything else is just lights and a couple of wheels.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, that's clear. Daytime firings suit solar well. Could one of our surveyors visit the studio next week?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. Any day except Tuesday, I can't leave the kiln.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Then Wednesday 7 October at 10 am. Our surveyor Ottoline will meet you there.
